passage: Last Tuesday evening, I joined my first online English class. Although I had studied English for many years, I had never spoken to a foreign teacher on a video call before, so I felt nervous when I turned on my computer. At eight, I signed up for the class and logged on to the meeting. The teacher, a kind woman from Canada, welcomed me and asked about my job. I told her that I worked as a Java developer and that I wanted to work for a foreign company. She smiled and asked me to describe my daily work in English. I spoke slowly at first, and I looked up two words in my notebook when I forgot them. Then she asked me to read a short passage aloud. I read it twice, and she corrected my pronunciation of three words. After the class, she wrote down my homework in the chat box and promised to check it next week. I turned off the computer and felt proud, because I had finally spoken English for forty minutes without stopping. I promised myself to join the class again next Tuesday.

coach_rationale: 今天继续磨两样老弱项：过去式 -ed 结尾听辨（signed up、logged on、turned on、looked up、turned off 都按正常语速连读出来），以及动词短语连读——这是你 EnglishPod365 笔记第 5–7 周小结里的主弱项；话题选“第一次上在线英语课”，贴你正在做的事，听的时候先抓短语、再抠 -ed。Mac 通道本轮不通，笔记没有新内容，今天只按日志里的错题模式出题。
